title: Balaji Srinivasan: How AI Will Change Politics, War, and Money

reader_summary.overview: So Polythistic AGI, I think, is one very useful macro frame. It means every culture has their own AGI. And eventually, every culture has their own social network and cryptocurrency and AI. You know, the AI is sort of like their Oracle is at the center of society.

key_points.text: In this episode, I'm joined by technologist and founder Bology Strenovason alongside A16Z General Partner, Martín Casado, to unpack how our language.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, I'm joined by technologist and founder Bology Strenovason alongside A16Z General Partner, Martín Casado, to unpack how our language, whether we frame AI as a god, a swarm or a tool, shapes our hopes and fears.

thesis: The speakers argue that the prevailing view of Artificial General Intelligence as a single, unitary entity is incorrect, proposing instead a 'polytheistic' framework where every culture develops its own distinct AI reflecting its specific values and constraints. They further assert that these culturally specific AIs, alongside decentralized social networks and cryptocurrencies, will form the core of network states, effectively creating a world where multiple superhuman intelligences operate as separate oracles rather than converging into a singular god-like system.
